items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: he was the son of the man who used to play the trumpet in the young Tuxedo Brass Band

ctx.x: But it was an interesting record.

I've still got that. And then there's another record that I have, and I think I must have bought it before I left New Orleans when I was through being in graduate school, and it's this Atlantic recording of the young Tuxedo Brass Band called Jazz Begins. Was that produced in 58, 59, 58? Yeah. Yeah. I've got that, and I have, that's a continuing pleasure to me. I still play that record a lot. And I was intrigued when I was down here last summer to hear a band one afternoon playing down at the gazebo, and when they…
so I'm glad to have that.
